Rae Kim: Heads up  we want the release blog + benchmark appendix + webinar tomorrow. Target publish 09:20am PT but will hold until ops gives the okay after canary. Need changelog URL and docs ready.

Omar Vega: Changelog will be available once the release PR merges. Expect https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v1.2. Docs landing at /docs/release/v1.2. Ops, what's the canary schedule?

publish-bot: Canary planned: 2026-05-04T08:40:00Z -> 10% (08:40Z), 50% (08:55Z), 100% (09:10Z). Monitor: /ops/deploys/17900.

Tess Li: Marketing prefers publish 09:25am PT to give 15m observation after full rollout. If canary pauses, we hold. Also need quickstart snippet cherrypick for auth header.

Hannah B: I'll do the cherrypick at 08:10am PT and queue the docs build. Expect CDN to serve by ~09:00am PT. ML approved numbers: use exact phrasing "p95 latency improved 19% under production batching; token cost down ~21% on our chat mix."

Omar Vega: Noted. I'll post the changelog link in-thread when live. Also add a small migration note for Dedicated customers about pinning.

publish-bot: Canary stage1 complete (10%). Stage2 started at 08:55Z. No major alerts.

Hannah B: Cherrypick merged. Docs landing live at https://redwood.ai/docs/release/v1.2. Changelog URL pending final merge.

Omar Vega: Release PR merged. Changelog now live: https://redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v1.2.

Rae Kim: Links received  marketing will schedule CMS for 09:25am PT publish and swap final anchors. Sam  queue webinar reminder 10m and 1m out.

publish-bot: Canary reached 100% at 09:10Z. Monitoring green.

Rae Kim: Publishing CMS now. Will post post-launch notes after webinar with linkbacks and top Qs. :rocket:
